choice.basis: The dashboard's pie chart explicitly labels each energy source category with its global consumption share: Fossil Fuels (50%), Renewables (25%), Nuclear (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). The chart title 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' confirms the scope. The largest share, 50%, is attributed to Fossil Fuels. The task requires routing the largest category to priority source monitoring.
choice.option_label: Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring
